notes: SEC-3 route policy. Routes listed here are the only runtime routes allowed to lack FastAPI-level auth dependencies. Auth-flow entries may still authenticate internally; moving those checks into dependencies should shrink this file over time. The 'authenticated' policy below describes a bootstrapped deployment: while auth_enabled is false (first run) the routes named in app.core.security._PRE_BOOTSTRAP_SETUP_SURFACE run as the admin sentinel and every other route answers 401, and under the CB_LEGACY_AUTH rollback the sentinel is granted everywhere.

security_review.required_review: Any change that adds, removes, or changes a route in this allowlist requires a CODEOWNERS-enforced security-owner review before merge.
